# Wavelengthz

> Wavelengthz is a music-taste dating app: a Spotify-powered matchmaking
> platform that pairs people by what they actually listen to, not just a
> photo grid. It's built for anyone who's ever wanted a dating app based on
> music taste, Spotify compatibility, or shared musical personality rather
> than a swipe-on-looks-only format.

## What Wavelengthz is

Wavelengthz connects people through their real Spotify listening history —
top artists, top tracks, and genres — blended into a match score alongside
traditional dating preferences (age, distance, gender, what someone is
looking for). It's a hybrid of a music-discovery app and a dating app: two
swipe modes let a member browse either people or music, so "date someone
with your taste in music" and "find music through people with your taste"
are the same product, not two separate features bolted together.

## How it works

- **Two swipe modes.** Music mode surfaces artists and tracks to like or
  pass on, refining a member's taste profile over time and feeding both
  Daily Drop and match scoring. People mode surfaces other members, ranked
  by a blended music-compatibility + traditional-preference score.
- **Sign-in via Spotify or Google** — no separate password, no manual
  profile-building for music taste; it's pulled straight from a member's
  real listening history.
- **Daily Drop** — one shared music prompt a day, answered with a song,
  browsable against everyone else's answer — a lower-stakes daily habit
  than swiping.
- **Matching and messaging** — a mutual like unlocks real-time messaging
  and a running shared playlist with that match.
- **Groups** — small, song-centered group chats anyone can start from a
  track they're into.
- **Trust & safety** — block/report, automated photo and message
  moderation, and a 7-day account-deletion grace period.

## Who it's for

People who find "swipe on a photo grid" dating apps shallow, and want
compatibility to start from something they actually care about — their
music taste — rather than a curated bio. Particularly relevant for anyone
searching for a "Spotify dating app," "music matching app," "dating app
for music lovers," or a way to meet people through shared taste in artists
and genres rather than appearance alone.

## Data and privacy

Nearly everything past the homepage requires a signed-in session — member
profiles, matches, messages, and the swipe deck are private and not meant
to be crawled, scraped, or used as training data, regardless of how
they're technically reachable. See `robots.txt` and the policies below for
the enforcement mechanism and the full detail.

## Policies

- [Terms of Service](https://wavelengthz.com/terms): the agreement governing use of the app, including an 18+ age requirement and a binding-arbitration clause.
- [Privacy Policy](https://wavelengthz.com/privacy): what we collect (Spotify/Google profile data, location, photos, messages), who we share it with, and how to exercise deletion/access rights.
- [Community Guidelines](https://wavelengthz.com/guidelines): what's expected of every member.
- [Safety Tips](https://wavelengthz.com/safety): practical guidance for meeting someone from the app in person.
- [Cookie Policy](https://wavelengthz.com/cookies): the short, complete list of what's stored in your browser.
- [DMCA / Copyright Policy](https://wavelengthz.com/dmca): how to file a copyright takedown notice.
